title: A decades-long breakthrough in zero-density estimates and primes in short intervals
summary: The Riemann Hypothesis (RH) asserts that every nontrivial zero of the Riemann zeta-function has real part equal to $1/2$. A zero-density theorem provides evidence towards RH by bounding the number of zeros of the zeta-function with real part greater than $1/2$. In 2024, Larry Guth and James Maynard announced a new zero-density theorem which, for a key location in the critical strip, strengthens previous work of Ingham and is the first such improvement in over 80 years.
